# ProofGate

> ProofGate is a local security gate for AI-written web apps (Python/Flask, Next.js + Supabase).
> It runs 9 layers of checks, proves access-control bugs by attacking the app as a second user
> on a local throwaway database, and only accepts fixes that stop the attack while the owner's
> feature still works. Nothing is uploaded; the website does not scan code.

## Install
- [Claude Code plugin](https://<site>/install#claude-code): `/plugin marketplace add Rudraksh-wq/Proofgate` then `/plugin install proofgate@proofgate`
- [MCP server (Claude Code)](https://<site>/install#mcp): `pipx install proofgate-ai`, then `claude mcp add proofgate --scope user -- proofgate-mcp` (or `uvx --from proofgate-ai proofgate-mcp`)
- [MCP server config, Claude desktop and others](https://<site>/install#mcp): `{"mcpServers":{"proofgate":{"command":"proofgate-mcp"}}}`
- [CLI](https://<site>/install#cli): `pipx install proofgate-ai && proofgate init`
